#### Product Details

 Sawdust is a by-product produced when processing logs and is classified according to species. Mixed sawdust is produced by mixing acacia, pine and rubber trees. Mixed Sawdust is soft and fragrant, and is used for a variety of purposes, such as for livestock rugs and mushroom cultivation. T-global produces and supplies products to meet the diverse needs of customers. In line with the livestock manure regeneration policy promoted in Korea recently, sawdust is being selected as a very suitable raw material for producing fertilizer by mixing with livestock manure. Due to these various uses, the demand for mixed sawdust from Vietnam continues to increase
